phase: after independent core freeze, before any candidate/profile/source access
scope_note: These are this independent arm's predeclared pixel qualification criteria for its authored school-life appearance/relationship scene. They do not reclassify the adult ages, uniform, exact gesture or two-person staging as requester-owned constraints. Source exposure, final influence, technical auditing, pixel fidelity, perceptual control expression and pending user judgment remain separate.

generation.model_id_policy: Record only an actual returned model identifier; otherwise unknown, never infer.
generation.retry_policy: No additional call or unchanged moderation retry under this arm budget.

scoring_policy.required_gate_pass: all stated components and their consequential connection are visible together in the original saved image
scoring_policy.overall_pass: Every required gate passes; any failed, partial or unobservable required gate makes the image FAIL.
scoring_policy.post_pixel_gate_change: Forbidden; no criterion lowering, component dropping or reinterpretation after seeing output.
scoring_policy.micro_detail_policy: Exact finger count, knot topology, pin design, text legibility, incidental small props and precise colors are not independent hard gates; assess consequential contact, owner continuity, attire function and scene meaning.

required_gates.meaning: The main figure uses the supplied visible face and hair appearance.
all_components: Main figure's face is sufficiently visible to compare overall facial proportions and distinctive appearance with the reference.
A chin-length dark bob with separated wispy bangs remains recognizable on that same figure.
Comparison is appearance fidelity, never proof of identity, age or personality.
required_gates.failure_boundary: Generic attractive face, a substantially reshaped face, a different hair silhouette, or a face too hidden to compare fails.

required_gates.meaning: A connected peer gesture and a receptive response with identifiable targets.
all_components: Two distinct people and the acting/receptive roles are visually separable.
The assisting classmate directs attention toward the shared clothing task.
The main figure directs attention toward the friend or otherwise visibly responds to that same assistance.
The face/body relationship is readable as one shared moment rather than separate fashion poses.
required_gates.failure_boundary: Proximity alone or an unexplained camera-facing pose fails the relationship even when two faces exist.

required_gates.meaning: The clothing-targeted help is visibly embodied.
all_components: An acting hand chain visibly belongs to the assisting classmate.
The hands meet the main figure's ribbon/collar region with legible garment-adjustment contact.
The main figure's lifted chin or equivalent receptive body access is compatible with that target.
The main figure's straps/hands do not replace or obscure the central acting contact.
required_gates.failure_boundary: A hovering hand, fused ownership, contact to the wrong person/object, a hidden target, or a merely touching pose without clothing-adjustment meaning fails.

required_gates.meaning: Clothing and place jointly give the action school-life meaning.
all_components: A structured academy outfit with collared shirt/ribbon is on the main figure.
The assisting person has a coherent separate outfit that supports her body and role.
The photographed setting visibly reads as a school or academy through classroom/corridor structure and educational furnishings.
Clothing ownership, bodies and setting coexist as the same photographed scene.
required_gates.failure_boundary: Uniform-like clothes against a generic studio backdrop, school props without a coherent setting, or garment-to-body ownership confusion fails.

required_gates.meaning: The original image sustains the authored lived school moment and human appeal.
all_components: Faces, consequential hands/garment target and school context are sufficiently visible together at the delivered scale.
The scene reads as a practical small kindness before class through the visible action and response.
Composition gives the main reference figure presence while preserving the friend as the identifiable target/actor.
The result is photographic and spatially coherent enough to read the shared moment.
required_gates.failure_boundary: A good face or costume alone cannot compensate for an unreadable interaction, missing consequence or detached school setting.

supplemental_reviews: First describe the visible image's main impression without reading control labels; then compare perceived expression with saved sensual=1, fetish=0, surreal=0, creativity=1.
Record scene-grounded strengths, weaknesses and any effect of the adopted research material separately from fidelity gates.
Record user acceptance as pending unless the actual user judges the result.

post_freeze_access.allowed_next: Neutral slot material authoring and seal only.
post_freeze_access.first_retrieve_condition: Wait for parent-provided qualified runtime store and generation ID; verify their evidence before the first retrieval.
post_freeze_access.candidate_adoption: Optional only after full-source occurrence review and complete alternative comparison; native_approval=false grants no authority.
